discovered_via: Public pricing endpoint called by Tesla's own Megapack order configurator at tesla.com/megapack/design. Same data the page shows a customer; read directly rather than scraped off the rendered DOM.
notes: Earliest selectable delivery was 2027 Q1; no 2026 quarters were offered.
Configurator returns totalPrice and annualMaintenancePrice only.

unit_specs._comment: Per-Megapack nameplate, confirmed linear in count: at n=5 the 4h config reads 4.9 MW / 19.6 MWh and at n=10 it reads 9.8 MW / 39.2 MWh. The 2h config trades usable energy for power, which is physically expected at a higher discharge rate.

by_delivery_quarter.finding: No price variation across delivery quarters. Tesla does not charge a premium for earlier delivery, so there is no expediting lever available at the order stage.

observed_structure: Price is exactly linear in count within 1-5 units: each additional 2hXL unit adds $1,004,205 and each 4hXL unit adds $937,975.
Both variations imply the SAME fixed order charge of $24,375, independent of size or configuration.
Per-unit price falls with volume and flattens around 20 units: the 2hXL marginal unit drops to $939,546 and the 4hXL to $877,581, roughly a 6-7% volume discount.
State pricing forms a freight gradient with CA and NV cheapest. Hawaii (+7.7%) and Puerto Rico (+8.0%) are highest, consistent with shipping distance from the Lathrop, CA Megafactory.
